Usage:
  kestrun [--nocheck] [--kestrun-folder <folder>] [--kestrun-manifest <path-to-Kestrun.psd1>] run [--script <main.ps1> | <main.ps1>] [--arguments <script arguments...>]

Options:
  --script <path>             Optional named script path (alternative to positional <main.ps1>).
  --kestrun-manifest <path>   Use an explicit Kestrun.psd1 manifest file.
  --arguments <args...>       Pass remaining values to the script as script arguments.

Notes:
  - If no script is provided, ./Service.ps1 is used.
  - Script arguments must be passed after --arguments (or --).
  - Use --kestrun-manifest to pin a specific Kestrun.psd1 file.
  - If Kestrun is missing, run 'kestrun module install'.

result.stdout:
Usage:
  kestrun module install [--version <version>] [--scope <local|global>]
  kestrun module update [--version <version>] [--scope <local|global>] [--force]
  kestrun module remove [--scope <local|global>]
  kestrun module info [--scope <local|global>]

Options:
  --version <version>      Optional specific version for install/update.
  --scope <scope>         Module storage scope: 'local' (default) or 'global'.
  --force                 Overwrite existing target version folder for update operations.

Notes:
  - install: fails when Kestrun is already installed; use 'kestrun module update'.
  - update: updates to latest when no --version is provided and fails if the target version folder exists unless --force is supplied.
  - remove: removes all installed versions from the selected scope and shows deletion progress in interactive terminals.
  - info: shows installed module versions and latest Gallery version for the selected scope.
  - Windows global scope for install/update/remove prompts for elevation (UAC) when needed.

Usage:
  kestrun [--nocheck] [--kestrun-manifest <path-to-Kestrun.psd1>] service install [--package <path-or-url-to-.krpack>] [--service-log-path <path-to-log-file>] [--service-user <account>] [--service-password <password>] [--deployment-root <folder>] [--runtime-source <path-or-url>] [--runtime-package <path-to-.nupkg-or-folder>] [--runtime-version <version>] [--runtime-package-id <package-id>] [--runtime-cache <folder>] [--content-root-checksum <hex>] [--content-root-checksum-algorithm <name>] [--content-root-bearer-token <token>] [--content-root-header <name:value> ...] [--content-root-ignore-certificate] [--arguments <script arguments...>]
  kestrun [--nocheck] service update --name <service-name> [--package <path-or-url-to-.krpack>] [--kestrun | --kestrun-module <path-to-Kestrun.psd1-or-folder> | --kestrun-manifest <path-to-Kestrun.psd1-or-folder>] [--deployment-root <folder>] [--content-root-checksum <hex>] [--content-root-checksum-algorithm <name>] [--content-root-bearer-token <token>] [--content-root-header <name:value> ...] [--content-root-ignore-certificate] [--failback]
  kestrun service remove --name <service-name>
  kestrun service start --name <service-name> [--json | --raw]
  kestrun service stop --name <service-name> [--json | --raw]
  kestrun service query --name <service-name> [--json | --raw]
  kestrun service info [--name <service-name>] [--json]

Options (service install):
  --package <path-or-url>     Required .krpack (zip) package containing Service.psd1 and app files.
  --content-root-checksum <h> Verify package checksum before extraction (hex string).
  --content-root-checksum-algorithm <name>  Hash algorithm: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512 (default: sha256).
  --content-root-bearer-token <token>  Add Authorization: Bearer <token> for HTTP(S) package download.
  --content-root-header <name:value>  Add custom HTTP request header for HTTP(S) package download. Repeatable.
  --content-root-ignore-certificate  Ignore HTTPS certificate validation for package download (insecure).
  --deployment-root <folder>  Override where per-service bundles are created (default is OS-specific).
  --runtime-source <path-or-url>  Override runtime acquisition using a local folder, local .nupkg, direct .nupkg URL, NuGet service index, or flat-container base URL.
  --runtime-package <path>    Use an explicit local Kestrun.Service.<rid> .nupkg for offline installs.
  --runtime-version <version> Override the runtime package version (defaults to the current tool version). When used without --package, only the runtime cache is populated.
  --runtime-package-id <id>   Override the runtime package id (defaults to Kestrun.Service.<rid>).
  --runtime-cache <folder>    Override the local runtime package cache directory.
  --kestrun-manifest <path>   Use an explicit Kestrun.psd1 manifest for the service runtime.
  --service-log-path <path>   Set service bootstrap/operation log file path.
  --service-user <account>    Run installed service/daemon under a specific OS account.
  --service-password <secret> Password for --service-user on Windows service accounts.
  --arguments <args...>       Pass remaining values to the installed script.
  --kestrun                   For service update: use repository module at src/PowerShell/Kestrun when newer than bundled module.
  --kestrun-module <path>     For service update: module manifest path or folder to refresh bundled Kestrun module.
  --failback                  For service update: restore application/module from latest backup and delete that backup folder.
  --json                      For service start/stop/query/info: output JSON instead of table/human-readable text.
  --raw                       For service start/stop/query: output native OS command output.

Notes:
  - install registers the service/daemon but does not auto-start it.
  - update fails when the service is running; stop it first.
  - update requires at least one of --package or --kestrun-module/--kestrun-manifest unless --failback is used.
  - --kestrun updates bundled module only when repository module version is newer; otherwise update is skipped with an informational message.
  - --failback restores from latest backup and fails when no backup is available.
  - info without --name lists installed Kestrun services.
  - Service name and entry point are read from Service.psd1 in the package.
  - Service.psd1 requires FormatVersion='1.0', Name, EntryPoint, and Description.
  - Package file must use .krpack extension and contain zip content.
  - install resolves a runtime package for the current RID using Kestrun.Service.<rid> packages.
  - install caches canonical runtime packages under packages/<id>/<version>/<id>.<version>.nupkg and extracted working payloads under expanded/<id>/... .
  - install can be used without --package to prefetch a runtime package into cache only; supply at least one runtime acquisition option.
  - install does not fall back to the runtime bundled with Kestrun.Tool when package acquisition fails.
  - use --runtime-package for offline installs or --runtime-source to point at a local feed/NuGet endpoint.
  - --content-root-checksum is validated against the package file before extraction.
  - --content-root-bearer-token is used for HTTP(S) package URLs and HTTP(S) runtime-source downloads.
  - --content-root-header is used for HTTP(S) package URLs and HTTP(S) runtime-source downloads; it can be supplied multiple times.
  - --content-root-ignore-certificate applies only to HTTPS package URLs/runtime-source URLs and is insecure.
  - --deployment-root overrides the OS default bundle root used during install and remove cleanup.
  - --service-user enables platform account mapping: Windows service account, Linux systemd User=, macOS LaunchDaemon UserName.
  - install snapshots runtime/module/script plus the dedicated service host from the resolved runtime package into a per-service bundle before registration.
  - install shows progress bars during bundle staging in interactive terminals.
  - bundle roots: Windows %ProgramData%\Kestrun\services; Linux /var/kestrun/services or /usr/local/kestrun/services (with user fallback); macOS /usr/local/kestrun/services (with user fallback).
  - remove/start/stop/query require --name and do not accept script paths.
  - Use 'kestrun module install' before service install when Kestrun is not available.
